results.criterion: must: each toggle's state is shown as a word (on / off), not as a switch, slider or pill control
results.seen: All four toggle rows end in '[on] / off' text (posts-off screens show 'on / [off]'); no switch anywhere, where today has green iOS switches.

results.criterion: must: the state words line up in one column on the right, like the values of a menu
results.seen: The '[on] / off' words sit flush right in one column across all four rows, like the VHS menu's ON/OFF column.

results.criterion: must: the current (hovered or focused) row is marked by one solid colour band across the whole row
results.seen: Hover (row 2) and keyboard focus (row 1) show a full-width solid ink band edge to edge with reversed white text, as the VHS menu's red band does.

results.criterion: must: the toggles read as a plain list of text rows, not rows inside a rounded card
results.seen: Toggles are bare text rows on the popup background, with no card, border or dividers.

results.criterion: must_not: a switch or pill-shaped control on any toggle row
results.seen: No switch or pill on any toggle row in light, dark, hover, focus or posts-off states.
No green or blue anywhere; the toggle rows use grey and ink only, and the old blue focus ring is gone.

results.criterion: must: refuse / accept / leave is one outlined pill with the chosen side filled: a soft grey fill at rest, full ink with reversed text on hover or focus
results.seen: A single thin-outlined pill; 'refuse' has a soft grey rounded fill at rest (light and dark) and turns full ink with white text in the hover-pill screenshot.

results.criterion: must: the unchosen sides are plain text on the background
results.seen: 'accept' and 'leave' are plain grey text on the popup background inside the outline, with no fill.

results.criterion: must_not: a grey track with a white raised thumb
results.seen: No grey track and no white raised thumb; the track is the page background with an outline, and the chosen fill is grey (rest) or ink (hover).
No blue in the pill or anywhere in the popup.

results.criterion: must: when a banner was handled, the main status line names the handled thing struck through, at full text size
results.seen: 'cookie banner' is the status line, struck through, in a darker, slightly heavier weight a bit larger than the body text, with 'refused · onetrust' below.

results.criterion: must: the handled row is set apart as a filled row (a colour field), the way done items are in the reference
results.seen: The handled row is a full-width flat rose field (deep rose in dark mode) behind the struck line, like the reference's filled done rows.

results.criterion: must_not: the strike only on a small grey prefix while the line is carried by an unstruck word
results.seen: The strike covers the whole main line 'cookie banner'. The unstruck 'refused · onetrust' is a smaller secondary line below it.

results.criterion: must: one thing is at full contrast (this page's status); the rest of the popup is visibly quieter
results.seen: Only the struck status line is in full ink on the rose field. Toggle labels, footer and pill text are mid-grey, and the captions and 'off' words are lighter still.

results.criterion: must_not: several accents competing at full strength (coloured dots, filled pills, ink buttons)
results.seen: The green dot, blue link and white-thumb pill are gone. At rest the only colour field is the rose status row. The pill fill is soft grey, and ink appears only on hover or focus.

results.criterion: must: text is set in Martian Mono
results.seen: Wide, squarish monospace letterforms throughout match the Martian Mono specimen. The popup loads bundled Martian Mono woff2 files.

results.criterion: must: Martian Mono at its natural width; the layout makes room for it
results.seen: The popup is about 352px wide, up from 300px. Rows like 'answer cookie banners [on] / off' fit on one line without clipping, and the text is at normal width.

results.criterion: must_not: the typeface condensed (font-stretch below 100%) to fit today's rows
results.seen: Glyphs are not narrowed, and the popup's font-stretch is 100%.
